title: Batch export profile (column map), contract_version 2
description: The machine-readable form of docs/contracts/batch-column-map.md, contract_version 2. This schema expresses SHAPE only. The catalogue-dependent rules (field exists, field is served, row_field required/refused by shared wire name, landing names a declared column, duplicate outputs, granularity against field scope) are NOT expressible in JSON Schema and live in doc_tools/batch/profile.py.

granularity.description: Contract section 2: one row per (notice, part) or per notice. Closed.

source.description: Contract section 4. field is the catalogue name (dotted), not the wire property.

format.description: Contract section 6: the only accepted value.

allOf.description: Contract section 5: on_unresolvable land requires a landing column.
Contract section 5: a landing is only meaningful when on_unresolvable is land.
Contract section 6: a date column needs BOTH on_unresolvable land and a landing.
